verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a public API for programmatically driving Lindy itself. The MCP docs describe Lindy connecting to other products' MCP servers, which is client-side. The 'write its own integration against the tool's API' line refers to third-party tools' APIs. Slack slash commands are a chat interface, not a public API. All OpenAPI/Swagger probe paths returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
